notes: Notebook created as baseline/teddy-02, renamed by user to teddy-002 (same notebook id). Memory check before run: none found. Genie reported: TeddyGModel fails on current transformers ('all_tied_weights_keys'); it re-implemented the encoder in plain PyTorch with the same weights (strict load, MLM decoder dropped).
